entries.zh: 外家；妻方亲属（妻子的娘家亲眷）
entries.en: wife's relatives; one's in-laws on the wife's side (the wife's natal family)

entries.zh: 势家；有权势的官宦之家（官亲、乡绅势族）
entries.en: powerful family; kinsfolk of a mandarin, an official's influential house

entries.zh: 族侄；同族子侄辈〔西栏却释作“国王的亲戚”，两栏语义不合〕
entries.en: clan nephew(s); kinsmen of one's clan — the manuscript's Spanish gloss reads 'relatives of the king'
entries.notes: 汉字栏为“族姪[疑:姪/侄]”而西栏释 parientes del Rey，两栏不合且字辨存疑，以汉字为主释义并降置信。

entries.zh: 寒族人；贫寒的亲族
entries.en: poor kinsman; relative in poverty, member of a humble clan

entries.zh: 大家；婆婆（旧称，夫家之母）
entries.en: mother-in-law (the husband's mother)

entries.zh: 殿下；国王近亲（王子、亲王）之尊称
entries.en: His Highness; honorific title of a prince, a close kinsman of the king

entries.zh: 生；分娩、生育（下产）
entries.en: to give birth; to bear a child

entries.zh: 娩；妇人分娩产子（西栏“妇人生男”）
entries.en: to give birth (of a woman), to bear a male child

entries.zh: 分；分娩（妇人生产之“分”）
entries.en: to give birth; fen, parturition (as in fenmian)

entries.zh: 分娩；妇人生产〔首字辨存疑：妨/分〕
entries.en: childbirth; a woman in labor giving birth (likely fenmian)
entries.notes: 首字原稿辨“妨/分”，据音写 hún Biē̃ 与西栏同义（承第8条“娩”）定为“分娩”，降置信。

entries.zh: 生子；生育子女
entries.en: to give birth to a child; to bear offspring

entries.zh: 月内；产后坐月的时期（分娩后的一个月内）
entries.en: the month following childbirth; postpartum confinement period

entries.zh: 交谈；说话、互语（官话栏注 comunicar，互通言语）
entries.en: to converse, to talk with one another; to communicate

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西栏存“Partida y hir pahcon. papera”，汉字、闽南语、官话三栏皆[空]，无从互证，不产释义。

entries.zh: 眼皮；目睭（眼睑）〔末字辨存疑：腘/肚〕
entries.en: eyelid
entries.notes: 第三字原稿辨“腘/肚”，据西栏 Parpado 与“目睭”定释为眼皮，末字存疑降置信。

entries.zh: 眼皮；目睭皮
entries.en: eyelid (the skin of the eyelid)

entries.zh: 部；书籍的分部门类
entries.en: section or division of a book; part

entries.zh: 段；文章的段落
entries.en: paragraph; passage or section of a book

entries.zh: 选字；书中的用字措辞〔首字辨存疑：揮/選〕
entries.en: chosen characters; wording of a book (first character doubtful: hui 'to wield' vs xuan 'to select')
entries.notes: 首字原稿辨“揮/選”，据西栏 parrafo de libro 暂定为“择字/措辞”，降置信。

entries.zh: 铁烤架；铁焙（铁制炙烤器具，parrillas 旧时亦指烤烙刑具）〔首字辨存疑：鐵/鉗〕
entries.en: iron grills, roasting irons (parrillas; in the period also a torture grate)
entries.notes: 首字原稿辨“鐵/鉗”，据西栏 Parrillas 与音写 tŷ pue 暂定为铁制烤架，降置信。
